idea-plugin.name: AST Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Explore Java and Kotlin code through interactive UAST visualizations.

AST Lens helps developers inspect source structure and understand relationships across a file or an entire project directly inside IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Visualize UAST structure, method calls, and class or package dependencies.
  • Compare the PSI and UAST representations of the same source file.
  • Navigate bidirectionally between graph nodes and source code.
  • Find callers, callees, dependants, implemented interfaces, and inheritors.
  • Detect large classes, complex methods, and circular dependencies.
  • Filter syntax noise and export graphs as JSON, Mermaid, or Graphviz.

Privacy: all analysis runs locally. AST Lens does not collect telemetry and does not transmit source code or analysis results to external services.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial Java and Kotlin K2 UAST visualization.
  • Added project-wide call and dependency graphs with incremental caching.
  • Added PSI/UAST comparison, relationship queries, and code health checks.
  • Added JSON, Mermaid, and Graphviz exports.
  • Added bidirectional navigation between graphs and source code.
